name: Ring Triceps Extension
cues: Set the rings around chest height and lean into them on straight arms
Keep a rigid plank from head to heels
Bend your elbows to bring your forehead between the rings
Press back to straight arms by moving only at the elbows

qa.note: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: Rigid plank pivots about the feet (pelvis tilt 38 to 60 deg) while only the elbows flex (10 to 110 deg). Rings and straps stay put and the head drops below the rings at the bottom. Feet slip 0.10 mm, sink 26 mm against 30 tolerance (tucked toes). Straps are 235 mm or more from the forearm axis.
